disposition_reason: Retrospective clinical review documenting oral bismuth oxide and bismuth citrate dosing (4 x 120 mg daily) and eradication outcomes; no bismuth concentrations or adverse events.

study.method: Outcome by 14C breath test or stool antigen; bismuth not measured

regulatory_or_exposure: Oral bismuth oxide or bismuth citrate 4 x 120 mg daily within H. pylori regimens (Table 16, p. 17).
non_numeric_findings: Bismuth preparations did not differ significantly in eradication success (p = 0.0670, Table 9, p. 10).
Probiotics increased success of bismuth-containing regimens (Table 8, p. 10).
